checkedAlternates.risk: Lambic is fermented at ambient temperatures like an ale.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Lambic relies on airborne wild Brettanomyces and bacteria in open coolships (group-1), not pitched Saccharomyces ale yeast (group-4).
Hefeweizen and Witbier are defined by high malted/unmalted wheat grain bills (group-2), unlike all-barley ales (group-4).
